items.summary: XSR-754 delivers the preinstalled protected helper, independent publisher verification, Windows/Unix immutable slots, offline recovery, activation, rollback, restart and idle-safe UI progress. XSR-755 adds signed content-defined file deltas, full fallback and authenticated history publishing while preserving the v1 release envelope. Managed interruption and actual loopback HTTP regressions pass. Windows Setup creates administrator-owned objects before copy; Launcher Build validates installed-helper admission and native transactions on six RIDs, including publisher-generated delta consumption. Physical acceptance remains separate; legacy staged helpers stay refused.
remaining: Exercise physical power-loss and replacement races on all three operating systems; assigned to Dots because the user has no available devices.

items.summary: PCL-N Host now implements lifecycle negotiation, numeric typed Command/State/Event/Intent, streams/credits, supervision, finite primitive Function ABI/compiler shapes, same-session semantic binding and bounded interactive resource UI. Host tests and compiler fixtures establish those finite contracts. The independent Plugin SDK/execution engine and real-plugin acceptance remain external.

items.summary: PCL-N now delivers mod and multi-item updates with journaled rollback, scoped world/datapack metadata and health checks, snapshot capture/verify/preserved-original restore, bounded config editing, screenshot timeline/crop/native clipboard/share and actual file hashes against existing managed update baselines. These contracts preserve captured identity, cancellation and retired-page admission. Physical interaction and shared-directory acceptance remain separate.
remaining: Review physical shared-directory, cancellation, interruption and interaction evidence for the delivered management operations.

items.summary: An interactive early native startup lifetime now owns stage/error/cancel presentation and records native render submissions through shell handoff. Native memory pressure controls leased bitmap admission; nullable provider-qualified process GPU counters and resource percentiles retain metric definitions. Background admission and actual renderer/motion/raster diagnostics are implemented. Submission counters and decoded pixel charge do not prove physical display latency or GPU residency; physical KPI acceptance remains open.
remaining: Profile physical drag, animation and scroll tails and collect controlled idle/game resource and long-running evidence.
Validate supported OS pressure and driver GPU telemetry providers on physical Windows, macOS and Linux systems.
